text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup.
Though trembling 
with fear,
Meisho Doto declares T.M. Opera O 
to be her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though T.M. Opera O acts shocked on the 
outside... deep down, she welcomes the 
change. She proudly resolves to take on 
the challenge.
